children.text: Retired (#1016 slice 3f, 2026-09-11): the tray's SIGNAL domain is gone, and the rail row in its place opens the accepted Effects page as a ROUTE — the same treatment Loop settings has, because that page takes the whole screen and its editors are direct controls rather than a list that opens a dialog. It keeps the signal-path glyph and the first position for the reason Signal held them: the signal path is what the rest of the console configures. The tray now lands on Control, the first face the rail still has. Two things went with the domain: the lane-cache indicators (the only surface that drew them) and their preference, and the hosted-plugin browser — the accepted Add effects offers the factory catalogue and Single FX, this file draws no plugin entry, and the owner's call (2026-09-11) was to drop the browser rather than invent one. Plugin hosting stays in the engine and the repository, so a chain that still carries a plugin entry keeps working.
